songs.name: Caution (Do Not Stop On Tracks) Jam

ai_show_review.summary: Psychedelic Caution jam with high energy and Mickey's drum debut
ai_show_review.blurb: The partial soundboard captures a vivid Caution (Do Not Stop On Tracks) Jam that bursts into Feedback, showcasing the band’s late‑60s psychedelic turn. Mickey Hart makes his first appearance on drums toward the end, adding a fresh rhythmic layer. Jerry’s post‑show excitement underscores the significance of this excerpt.
ai_show_review.review: What unfolds at Dance Hall on September 4, 1967 is a rare glimpse into the Dead as they were stretching into deeper psychedelia. The set—though only two songs long—is dominated by an exploratory Caution (Do Not Stop On Tracks) Jam that erupts into a swirling Feedback section, delivering a high‑octane sonic ride that feels both raw and inspired. Jerry Garcia’s enthusiasm is palpable; after the performance he hugged Mickey Hart and declared, “THIS is the Grateful Dead,” a moment captured in the lore of the band’s early evolution. Phil Lesh anchors the improvisation with a throbbing bass line, while Mickey’s late‑night drum cameo adds an unexpected percussive texture that hints at his forthcoming permanent role. Despite audible tape splices, the recording remains fully listenable and offers a vivid snapshot of a pivotal creative moment.

best_recording.reason: Good‑quality soundboard despite rustic splice; captures the vivid Caution>Feedback jam and Mickey’s first drum appearance
